title: StarPortal
description: This plugin is created referencing the Stargate saga, although the plugin itself is a way for players to transport themselves through portals.
body:
![Starportal banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae7d8926d9a552933093dd7ba890e775e46b8674.jpeg)

StarPortal is a high-tech, professionally balanced portal system for Minecraft servers. Forget about simple teleporters; provide your players with a fully immersive, manageable, and energy-based network.

## 🔥 Key Features
⚡ **Energy-Driven Economy**: Portals require Ender Pearls to function. Configure initial costs, maintenance cycles, and interdimensional penalties to keep your server's economy perfectly balanced.

🛡️ **Advanced Iris Protection**: Protect your bases with an event-horizon shield. The Iris can be toggled to block incoming entities or disintegrate them on contact.

💻 **High-Tech Interfaces**: No complex commands needed. Manage your portals through sleek, custom GUIs (DHD and Core Configuration).

📡 **Smart Dialing System**: Use 6-digit addresses to connect to any portal in the world. Save your favorite destinations for quick access.

🤝 **Whitelist & Privacy**: Grant administrative access to friends. Only whitelisted users or the owner can rename, modify, or decommission the DHD.

🌍 **Multi-Language Support**: Fully localized in English and Spanish with easy-to-edit configuration files.

## 🚀 Why choose StarPortal?
Unlike other plugins, StarPortal focuses on immersion and balance. It’s designed to feel like a natural extension of the game, rewarding players for their resource management while providing a powerful tool for travel and community building.

## 📖 Installation & Quick Start
Requirement: Bukkit/Spigot/Paper 1.21.X.

Core Placement: Place a Beacon (this will be your portal core).

DHD Setup: Place a Lectern within 7 blocks of the core to act as your control panel.

Configuration: Right-click the Beacon to name your portal and generate its address.

Dialing: Use the Lectern (DHD) to enter a target address or access saved locations.

## 🛠️ Technical Specs
Version Compatibility: Minecraft 1.21.x

Soft Dependencies: None. StarPortal works out of the box!

Optimization: Light on server resources with smart ticking and asynchronous data management.
